headline: Care that’s matched to your body and your goals.
intro: Every session is personalized. Clara listens to your concerns first, then recommends the methods that are most effective for your body, comfort level, and lifestyle.
careBody: Whether you need relief from chronic tension, a calmer nervous system, better mobility, or a reset from a busy week, Clara matches the treatment to your body and your goals.
popularItems: Reflexology and bodywork for stress and circulation
Waxing and self-care services in a clean, supportive setting

serviceGroups.title: Additional Services
items: Add-ons: hot stone, cupping & essential oils

pricingBody: Pricing depends on the service, session length, and your goals, so Clara will recommend the best fit for you when you book. Call or text and we’ll help you choose the right visit.
pricingNote: Self-pay only. We do not accept insurance. Appointments are typically scheduled 1–2 weeks in advance.
ctaBody: Tell Clara what’s bothering you and she’ll recommend the best approach for your body.
